from dataclasses import replace
import pytest
from test_sql import Container, inert_boundary, installation, query, source, _FIXTURE
from strata_forge.datasets import sql
from strata_forge.datasets.sql_types import SQLExecutionError

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_complete_result_frame_followed_by_failed_actual_exit_is_not_success(monkeypatch):
    actual=Container.run
    async def failed_exit(self,**kwargs):
        outcome=await actual(self,**kwargs)
        return replace(outcome,exit_code=1)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Container,'run',failed_exit)
    with (_FIXTURE/'typed.parquet').open('rb') as opened:
        async with sql.LocalSQLExecutor(installation=installation()) as executor:
            with pytest.raises(SQLExecutionError):
                await executor.query(spec=query(),source=source(opened.fileno()))
    assert Container.instances[0].calls==1
    assert all(not p.exists() for p in Container.instances[0].directories)
